descriptions.en: Some of our intelligence assets have uncovered data suggesting that the [ringworld_builder.GetName]'s ring world could be hiding a secret launch platform for weapons of mass destruction. Though the validity of the source has yet to be confirmed, the notion has taken hold with the public who demand that we take action. Surely if the [ringworld_builder.GetName] has nothing to hide, they will allow a team of our weapons experts to inspect the site.

descriptions.zh: 自从[ringworld_builder.GetName]开始建造环形世界以来，我们的几位首席工程师一直在后方关注这个项目，对他们的进程记忆深刻。工程师们相信，我们可以通过在建造现场近距离观察进而从他们的建造技术中学到知识，并建议我们向建造国发出请求，派出一支研究团队驻扎在建造现场。
descriptions.en: Since the [ringworld_builder.GetName] started construction on a ring world, several of our leading engineers have been following the project from afar, and are greatly impressed with their progress. They believe we could learn from studying their craftsmanship closer, and suggest that we ask their permission to station a research team on location.

descriptions.zh:
[From.From.GetName]声称他们掌握了有关于我们在环形世界上建造大规模杀伤性武器的秘密发射平台的秘密情报，要求我们同意对建筑工地进行视察。

我们的军事顾问尚未确认这是无心之过还是恶意诽谤，但无论如何我们都要谨慎对待这一局面。
descriptions.en:
The [From.From.GetName] claims to have uncovered intel suggesting that we are building a secret launch platform for weapons of mass-destruction on our ring world and requests our permission to inspect the site.

Our military advisers have yet to confirm whether it's an honest mistake or something more sinister. Either way we should handle the situation delicately.

descriptions.zh: 为表诚意，[From.GetName]同意我们派出武器专家在他们的环形世界中搜寻潜藏的秘密发射平台。一批精挑细选的最杰出的武器专家已经动身出发，马上就能真相大白了。
descriptions.en: In good faith, the [From.GetName] has agreed to let a team of our weapons experts search their ring world for a hidden launch platform. A selection of our most qualified specialists are already headed to the site. Soon we will know the truth.

descriptions.zh: 令我们的科学团体激动的是，我们从[From.GetName]处收到消息，他们很荣幸能在他们在建的环形世界上招待我们的研究团队。我们的首席工程师已组织了我们最优秀的工程师团队迅速前往环形世界，以报告建造进度。
descriptions.en: To the excitement of the scientific community, we have received word that the [From.GetName] would be honored to host a team of our researchers on their ring world. The engineering chief has organized to send a delegation of our finest engineers there shortly, to report on the construction process.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]对我们的高规格出访致以热切的问候，承诺停止环形世界的建造工作，直到我们的宗教领袖感到满意，认定环形世界不会违背神的意志为止。

数位精选的神官已经立刻启程前往建造现场，以确保残酷的预言永远不会成真。
descriptions.en:
The [From.GetName] welcomes our efforts to align with a higher presence, and promises to halt all construction on the ring world till our religious leaders are satisfied that it won't interfere with divine will.

A handful of chosen officials are setting out for the construction site immediately, to ensure that the grim prophecy is never fulfilled.

descriptions.zh: 不幸的是[From.GetName]并没有同意我们的提议，此举恶化了我们两帝国间的关系。
descriptions.en: Unfortunately the [From.GetName] did not agree to our terms, worsening the relations between our empires.

descriptions.zh: 送去检查[From.GetSpeciesName]的环形世界的专家为搜寻秘密发射平台而找遍了整个建造平台，然而没有找到任何能支持我们宣称的东西。我们只能归结为我们情报部门存在缺陷，下次应该更谨慎地检查我们的情报来源。
descriptions.en: The experts sent to inspect the [From.GetSpeciesName] ring world have scoured the construction site for a secret launch platform, yet found nothing to back our claims. We can only conclude that our intelligence was faulty, and review our sources more carefully the next time.

descriptions.zh: 我们送去[From.GetSpeciesName]环形世界的研究者带回了工程学领域的新知识。虽然最初双方因文化差异而产生过一些误解，但是双方都对交换知识感到很满意，并从对方处学到了很多。
descriptions.en: The researchers we sent to the [From.GetSpeciesName] ring world have returned with new knowledge within the field of engineering. Despite some initial misunderstandings due to cultural differences, both teams were satisfied with the exchange and have learned much from each other.

descriptions.en: The religious officials sent to consecrate the [From.GetName]'s ring world, have returned from their mission with more questions than answers. Though unable to decipher the true meaning of the visions, they reassure us that "what may be, may never be..."

descriptions.zh: 在几乎把建造平台翻了个底朝天之后，来自[From.From.GetName]的武器专家终于而且只能承认我们的环形世界根本没有所谓的秘密武器发射平台。我们已经给够支持了，只要他们愿意相信……
descriptions.en: After picking half the construction site apart, the weapons experts from the [From.From.GetName] finally had to concede that there is no secret weapons launch platform on our ring world. An effort we could have spared them, if only they had trusted us...

descriptions.zh: 在环形世界待过几周后，来自[From.From.GetName]的工程师现已离开。虽然有文化上的差异，不过双方对交换知识感到很满意，并从对方处学到了很多。
descriptions.en: After spending several weeks on the ring world, the engineers from [From.From.GetName] have now left. Despite their cultural differences, both teams were satisfied with the exchange and have learned much from each other.

descriptions.zh: 在环形世界待过几周后，来自[From.From.GetName]的工程师现已离开。虽然有文化上的差异，不过双方对交换知识感到很满意，并从对方处学到了很多。
descriptions.en: After spending several weeks on the ring world, the engineers from [From.From.GetName] have now left. Despite their cultural differences, both teams were satisfied with the exchange and have learned much from each other.

descriptions.zh:
当他们在建造平台上冥想时，来自[From.From.GetName]的宗教领袖宣称他们进入了深层出神状态，期间他们发现环形世界根本不是不详景象的起因，虽然不愿意对景象的真正意义作最终解释，但他们留下了安抚人心的话：“可行之事，亦可不行……”

谢天谢地，建造工作终于能继续进行了。
descriptions.en:
As they were meditating on the ring world construction platform, the religious leaders from the [From.From.GetName] claim they entered a deep divinatory trance, during which they discovered that the ring world is not the cause of the ominous visions after all. Though unwilling to give a final answer on the true meaning of the visions, they left us with the comforting notion that "what may be, may never be..."

Thankfully construction can now begin again.

descriptions.zh: 在环形世界施工管事出色的领导下，我们能将建造流程最优化，显著加快了建造速度。
descriptions.en: Under the skillful leadership of the ring world construction manager, we have been able to optimize the construction workflow, increasing the build speed significantly.

descriptions.zh: 我们在环形世界上的建造团队发现了一大片矿藏着床于极硬的岩石中，而矿藏在建造过程中会碎裂。虽然易受影响，样本足以说明矿藏值得我们停下环形世界的建造来开发。
descriptions.en: The construction team on the ring world has discovered a large deposit of minerals embedded in extremely porous stone, that will disintegrate during the build process. Though sensitive, the sample could be valuable enough that it would be worth our while to halt construction to extract it.

options.script: name = utopia.22.b

descriptions.zh: 自从环形世界的建造工作开始后，一小部分工人失踪了。似乎他们乘坐着无数运输船中的一艘，未通知他们的上级就离开了，我们正在开展调查以寻求他们的去向。不幸的是他们未经允许的离开显著拖延了建造。
descriptions.en: Since construction on the ring world began, a number of workers have gone missing. Though it's likely they've simply left with one of the many transports without notifying their supervisors, we are launching an investigation into their whereabouts. Sadly their unexpected departure has delayed construction slightly.

descriptions.zh: 随着替补工人的到来，环形世界的建造工作终于回归正轨了。可惜的是我们还没有找到失踪的工人们，他们的家人已经得到通知了。
descriptions.en: With the arrival of replacement workers, construction on the ring world is finally back on track. Regrettably we have still not been able to locate the missing workers, whose families have now been notified.

label.zh: 我们的思念与他们同在。

options.script:
name = utopia.28.a
country_event = { id = utopia.23 days = 20 }

descriptions.zh:
似乎我们用来建造环形世界的一颗星球并不像我们开始想的那样不可居住，一种看起来无害，但之前未知的物种——昵称为“可可”的巨型太空蠕虫——被我们用它们母星的碎片带到了环形世界。

由于它们那毛绒绒的毛皮和温顺的习性，这些可爱的生物很快就成为了工人们的最爱，毕竟他们远离家人，常年孤独地呆在这，尤其是处在有工人失踪的当下。

我们可以让这些生物继续和平生活在这儿，或者净化它们，显著延缓建造进度。
descriptions.en:
It appears as if one of the planets used to construct the ring world was not as uninhabited as we first thought. A seemingly harmless, but previously unknown species of giant space worm, nicknamed "Coo-coo" after its call, has been transferred to the ring world with fragments from its homeworld.

With their fuzzy fur and gentle demeanor, the endearing creatures have become an instant favorite with the workers, who are far away from their families and often very lonely. Especially in the light of their missing co-workers.

We could allow the creatures to continue their lives in peace, or purge them, delaying construction slightly.

options.script:
name = utopia.23.b
country_event = { id = utopia.25 days = 30 }

descriptions.zh:
出乎所有人的意料，环形世界爆发了一场彩色大喷发，成千上万的蠕虫——或者幼虫，现在看起来是的——蜕变为了蝴蝶。似乎这样的变化是因为大气层的产生而出现的。

不过狂欢马上就停止了。因为我们发现了一个地下通道网络，在通道里我们发现“可可”在用我们失踪工人的遗体进食。

直到这些生物被灭绝前，建造工作将暂停，不过我们预计工作将很快完成，因为工人们极度愤慨，“可可”的本性也就此揭露。
descriptions.en:
To everyone's amazement, the ring world has erupted into a flurry of color as thousands of space worms, or as it seems, larvae, are transforming into butterflies. Likely the change has been brought on by the generation of an atmosphere.

Unfortunately, celebrations have been cut short by the discovery of a subterranean network of tunnels, in which Coo-coos were caught feeding off the remains of several missing workers.

Construction has been halted till the creatures have been exterminated, but we expect swift results as the workers are highly motivated. The true nature of the Coo-coo has been revealed.

options.script: name = utopia.25.a

descriptions.zh:
我们负责清除巨型蠕虫“可可”的灭绝小队遭到了建造工人的暴力阻挠。

一个年轻人试图铤而走险，尝试藏住它的宠物。他到达了足够远离建造点的地方，掉入了一个新近挖掘的地下网络通道，在那他撞见几只“可可”在用失踪工人的残留物喂食。他的宠物试图向他喷射消化液，但他还是死里逃生。他立刻通知了灭绝小队，小队迅速消灭了这些肉食类蠕虫。

“可可”的本性也就此揭露。
descriptions.en:
The extermination team's efforts to rid the ring world of the giant space worms known as Coo-coos, have been aggravated by violent protests from the construction workers.

In a desperate attempt to hide his pet, one young man even ventured far enough outside the build site, that he stumbled upon a subterranean network of freshly dug tunnels, where he caught several Coo-coos feeding off the remains of his missing co-workers. After narrowly escaping from his beloved pet, as it tried to spray him with digestive fluids, he alerted the extermination team, which has made short work of the carnivorous worms.

And so the true nature of the Coo-coo has finally been revealed.

label.en: What a grisly turn of events.

options.script: name = utopia.26.a

descriptions.zh:
我们的帝国震惊地发现[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]正在[dyson_system.GetName]周围建造一个戴森球，那是我们最喜爱的星座——独眼漫步者——的中心恒星，而戴森球将完全阻隔她的光亮。

独眼漫步者，用她的独眼，自从我们的文明伊始便守望着我们，她的传奇不仅指引着我们的舰队，群星亦在天际间航行。而现在，[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]，伴随着他们浅显的傲慢，要用一个戴森球遮蔽她，弄瞎她。

虽然需要过上许多年，我们这才能感受到变化，但是当我们的人民得知她不能继续守望我们的下一代时，依然感到无比震惊。
descriptions.en:
Our empire has been shaken by the discovery that the [dysonsphere_builder.GetName] are building a Dyson Sphere around [dyson_system.GetName], a central star in one of our most beloved constellations, the "One-eyed Wanderer," completely blocking its light.

The Wanderer, with her single eye, has watched over our kind since the beginning of time, and legend has it that she guides not only our fleets, but the stars themselves in their journey across the sky. And now the [dysonsphere_builder.GetName], in their blatant ignorance, have built a sphere around her eye, blinding her.

Though it will take many years before we can tell a difference from here, our people are crushed that she will no longer be watching over future generations.

label.zh: 我们应得到一个正式的道歉。
1000能量币的赔款将缓解我们的痛苦。
label.en: A donation of 1000 credits could alleviate the pain.
Maintaining good relations with our neighbors comes first.

descriptions.zh:
我们发现您的帝国正在我们最喜爱的星座——独眼漫步者——的中心恒星上建造戴森球。

独眼漫步者自我们文明的伊始便用她的独眼守望着我们，她不仅指引着我们的舰队，群星亦在天际间航行，而您现在要在她的独眼上造一个戴森球，弄瞎她。

虽然我们要等很多年才能在母星感到变化，她不能继续守望的下一代的消息震惊了我们的人民，现在人民要求得到正式道歉。
descriptions.en:
We have discovered that you are building a Dyson Sphere around a central star in one of our most beloved constellations, the One-eyed Wanderer.

The Wanderer has watched over our kind since the beginning of time. With her single eye, she guides not only our fleets, but the stars themselves in their journey across the sky, and now you have built a sphere around it, blinding her.

Though it will take many years before we can tell the difference from here, the notion that she won't be watching over future generations has shaken our people and they deserve a formal apology.

label.zh: 给他们分享一些我们的能源币。
label.en: Share some of our energy with them.

descriptions.zh:
我们发现您的帝国正在我们最喜爱的星座——独眼漫步者——的中心恒星上建造戴森球。

独眼漫步者自我们文明的伊始便用她的独眼守望着我们，她不仅指引着我们的舰队，群星亦在天际间航行，而您现在要在她的独眼上造一个戴森球，弄瞎她。

虽然我们要等很多年才能在母星感到变化，她不能继续守望的下一代的消息震惊了我们的人民。而你，从另一方面来说，马上就能得到你想要的能量。一笔1000点能量币的赔偿也许能安抚你造成的痛苦。
descriptions.en:
We have discovered that you are building a Dyson Sphere around a central star in one of our most beloved constellations, the One-eyed Wanderer.

The Wanderer has watched over our kind since the beginning of time. With her single eye, she guides not only our fleets, but the stars themselves in their journey across the sky, and now you have built a sphere around it, blinding her.

Though it will take many years before we can tell the difference from here, our people are crushed that she won't be watching over future generations. You on the other hand, will soon have all the energy you require. A small donation of 1000 credits however, might help alleviate the pain you've caused.

label.zh: 我们没有足够的能量币，只能发表正式道歉。
label.en: We have no credits to spare, but issue a formal apology.

label.zh: 我们在自己国境内做的事可不关他们的事。
label.en: What we do within our borders is none of their concern.

descriptions.zh: 今天，[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]的[dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle][dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerName]私下会见了[dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerTitle][dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerName]，就致盲独眼漫步者一事致歉。他们向我们真诚地表达了懊悔，并坚称即使漫步者失去了光芒，也将一如既往地用信念和公义继续指引我们。
descriptions.en: Today [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle] [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerName] of the [dysonsphere_builder.GetName] met with [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerTitle] [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerName] in person to issue a formal apology to our empire for blinding the One-eyed Wanderer. They offered their sincerest regrets and remain confident that the Wanderer will continue to guide us, as she always has, using her strength of will and sense of justice, and not her sight.

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了你的要求，但是你们可能误解了我们之间的关系，让我们澄清此事：[dyson_system.GetName]是一颗我们星域内的恒星。或许你们难以搞清这个概念，但在我们星域内发生什么不关你们的事。同样，我们也不在乎你能否安抚你们的人民。

为避免更多误会，你们最好记住这点。
descriptions.en:
We have received your request and could not help but notice that there appears to be some confusion regarding the nature of our relationship. Allow us to clarify. [dyson_system.GetName] is a star within our space, and though this concept may be difficult for you to grasp, what happens within our space does not concern you. As it does not concern us whether you are capable of pleasing your people or not.

To avoid further confusion, in the future you will do well to remember this.

label.en: Don't dignify them with a response.

tooltips.zh: “你那可怜的小国马上就能体会到在宇宙中孤立无援的滋味了……”
tooltips.en: "Your pitiful empire will soon learn the meaning of being alone without a friend in the universe..."

descriptions.zh: 今天，[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]的[dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle][dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerName]与[dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerTitle][dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerName]亲自会面，为他们致盲独眼漫步者一事正式致歉。他们还赔偿我们1000点能量币以求弥补损失，并坚称即使漫步者失去了光芒，她还会一如既往地用信念与公义引导我们。
descriptions.en: Today [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle] [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerName] of the [dysonsphere_builder.GetName] met with [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerTitle] [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerName] in person to issue a formal apology to our empire for blinding the One-eyed Wanderer. They also offered us a gift of 1000 energy in the hopes of repairing some of the damage they've caused, and expressed confidence that the Wanderer will continue to guide us, as she always has, using her strength of will and sense of justice rather than her sight.

descriptions.zh: 今天，[dysonsphere_builder.GetName]的[dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle][dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerName]与[dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerTitle][dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerName]亲自会面，为他们致盲独眼漫步者一事正式致歉。尽管他们的道歉表面上很真诚，但他们拒绝赔付应有的补偿，理由是没有多余能源。
descriptions.en: Today [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle] [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerName] of the [dysonsphere_builder.GetName] met with [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerTitle] [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetRulerName] in person to issue a formal apology to our empire for blinding the One-eyed Wanderer. Though the apology seemed sincere, they refused to give us due compensation, claiming that they did not have the energy to spare.

descriptions.zh: 因为我们意外在他国最敬爱的恒星上修建了戴森球，为了弥补对[dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetName]人民的伤害，我们的[dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle]千里迢迢赶到他们的母星发表了诚挚道歉，然而他们认为我们的苦心毫无意义。
descriptions.en: In an attempt to repair some of the damage done to the people of the [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetName], when we accidentally constructed a Dyson Sphere around one of their most beloved stars, our [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle] traveled all the way to their homeworld to deliver a sincere apology. Yet, they have made it painstakingly clear that our efforts have been insufficient.

options.script: name = utopia.37.a
name = utopia.37.b

descriptions.zh:
为了弥补因为戴森球的建设而造成的对我国和[dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetName]关系的损失，我们的[dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle]千里迢迢赶到他们的母星并发表了诚挚道歉。

虽然他们还需要些时间才能从悲痛中振作，但他们感谢我们的付出。我们也希望从今往后两国的关系能得到改善。
descriptions.en:
In an attempt to repair some of the damage done to the relation between our empire and the [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetName], following the construction of a Dyson Sphere around one of their most beloved stars, our [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle] traveled all the way to their homeworld to deliver a sincere apology to their people.

Though it may take them some time to recover from their loss, they appreciated that we made an effort. Hopefully from now on the relations between our empires will only improve.

options.script: name = utopia.38.a

descriptions.zh:
感谢你们花费如此长的时间来提醒我们那根植在你们物种中的卑劣本性，在这之前我们确实被蒙骗了。

你那可怜的国家马上就能体会到在宇宙中孤立无援的滋味了。
descriptions.en:
We thank you for taking the time to enlighten us, as it seems we were indeed confused about many things. The true nature of your kind among others.

Your pitiful empire will soon learn the meaning of being alone without a friend in the universe.

label.en: We look forward to that day.

options.script: name = utopia.39.a

label.zh: 他们会为他们的傲慢付出代价的！

options.script: name = utopia.39.b
name = utopia.39.c

descriptions.zh: 我们的线报指出，[dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetName]的人民就我们阻隔他们喜爱的星座的中央恒星一事，对我们拒绝正式道歉表示极不满意。虽然我们没有收到和此事件有关的说明，[dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle]在一次演讲中表达了对我国的不满。
descriptions.en: Our informants report that the [dyson_sphere_neighbor.GetName] were greatly displeased by our refusal to issue a formal apology to their people for blocking the light of a central star in one of their star constellations. Though we've had no word from them regarding the incident, the [dysonsphere_builder.GetRulerTitle] expressed their disappointment in a speech addressing the empire.

descriptions.zh:
科学枢纽的理事会激动地发表声明，宣称他们将提供一次难得的机会以招募广受赞誉的科学家艾克斯哈索尔博士，这是一个在寿命延长领域享誉已久的名字。

他和他的团队研发的一种证实有良好寿命延长能力的血清已经到了研究的最终阶段，但此时他们已经花光了科研经费。然而招募艾克斯哈索尔博士意味着我们没有足够的资源以继续我们现行的，一项由葛洛亦克博士领导的有关有机工程的研究。她现在正试图把工程学研究与一台有机超级计算机串流。
descriptions.en:
The board of the Science Nexus are thrilled to announce that they have been given a unique opportunity to recruit widely acclaimed researcher Dr. Xhaxxore, a prominent name within the field of life-extension.

He and his staff were in the final stages of developing a serum that has shown good promise of prolonging life, when they ran out of funds. Hiring Dr. Xhaxxore however, means we will not have the resources to continue our current research into organic engineering, led by Dr. Groik. She is attempting to streamline engineering research with the use of an organic supercomputer.

label.zh: 用1000点能量币招募艾克斯哈索尔博士。
优先进行葛洛亦克博士的研究。
我们没钱招募艾克斯哈索尔博士。
label.en: We can't afford to hire Dr. Xhaxxore.

descriptions.zh:
艾克斯哈索尔博士和他的团队本周早些时候发表了他们的研究结果。据信，他们从[missing_pops_planet.GetName]上发现的香精中提取出了一种血清，当它被涂抹在皮肤上时，会引发史无前例细胞再生。

可惜的是现在有几个人就艾克斯哈索尔收到资金一事表示抱怨。葛洛亦克博士现在甚至指责艾克斯哈索尔是个骗子。现在她提出请求和500能量币的预算，以发起秘密调查。如果艾克斯哈索尔察觉他可能会反感并离开。
descriptions.en:
Dr. Xhaxxore and his team demonstrated the results from their research earlier this week. The serum, when applied to the skin, causes unprecedented cell regeneration, supposedly thanks to the miracle ingredient, "essence of [missing_pops_planet.GetName]", named after its mysterious origin.

Sadly, there have been complaints from a few individuals regarding the additional funding Xhaxxore received. Dr. Groik has even gone so far as to accuse Xhaxxore of being a fraud. Now she requests permission, as well as an additional budget of 500 credits, to launch a secret investigation. If Xhaxxore finds out he might take offense and leave.

label.zh: 并没有什么能支持她的说法。
label.en: There's nothing to back her claims.

options.script:
name = utopia.54.a
hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = utopia.58 days = 60 random = 20 } }

label.zh: 开始调查，凡事以安全为主。
label.en: Investigate, to be on the safe side.

descriptions.zh:
葛洛亦克博士对艾克斯哈索尔的研究的调查获得了有趣的结果。艾克斯哈索尔博士不仅极大夸大了血清的效果，还隐瞒了血清疗效只是暂时的这一事实。而且如果过度使用血清，副作用将是永久的。

精华本身也被查明，是提取自[ointment_name.GetName]星系的一个原生物种的腺体，经调查该生物正是[target_country.GetName]的[target_country.GetSpeciesName]。艾克斯哈索尔甚至在低温室囚禁了数个[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]以保证精华的供应。很明显如果他们要是发现了真相的话我们和他们帝国的外交关系将遭受极大损失。
descriptions.en:
Dr. Groik's investigation into Xhaxxore's research has yielded some interesting results. Not only has Dr. Xhaxxore greatly exaggerated the effects of the serum, he has neglected to mention that they are only temporary. The side-effects, however, when over-used, can be quite permanent.

The essence itself has been extracted from a gland found in a species native to the [ointment_name.GetName] system, none other than the [target_country.GetSpeciesName] of the [target_country.GetName]. Xhaxxore has held several [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] in cryostasis for months to secure the necessary supply of essence. It is likely that our diplomatic ties with their empire would suffer if they were to discover the truth.

label.zh: 终止项目并逮捕艾克斯哈索尔。此事绝不能让旁人知晓。
label.en: Terminate the project and apprehend Xhaxxore. No one can know.

options.script:
name = utopia.55.a
hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = utopia.56 days = 10 } }

label.zh: 让葛洛亦克闭嘴，把产品推销成延寿膏。
label.en: Silence Groik and market the product as anti-aging cream.

tooltips.zh: 伴随着强大的推销策略，这种产品短期内将收获巨大利润。
tooltips.en: With an intense marketing campaign the product may yield a hefty profit in the near future.

descriptions.zh:
可惜的是狡诈的艾克斯哈索尔博士溜过了我们的追捕，把他的团队和实验对象弃之不理。[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已被唤醒，幸运的是他们并没有回想起遭遇的一切。至于艾克斯哈索尔，他可能正逃往一个遥远的星系，用着不同的名字，计谋着下一场骗局。只要运气不坏，在他下一次失手时我们会抓住他的。

而他那不光彩的团队似乎是被他的个人魅力所迷惑了，就像我们那样。我们能提供给他们一次加入科学枢纽的机会以弥补他们的过错。
descriptions.en:
Regrettably the mysterious Dr. Xhaxxore has slipped through our clutches, leaving his staff and test-subjects behind. The [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been awoken and thankfully have no recollection of what they've been through. As for Xhaxxore he is probably already on his way to some distant system, under a different name, plotting his next con. With a little luck, the next time he slips up we will be there to catch him.

His disgraced staff seem to have been as blindsided as we were by his charm, and many have offered to join the Science Nexus permanently to make up for their mistakes.

options.script: name = utopia.56.a

label.en: They are welcome to join us.

label.zh: 他们显然不是星系间最耀眼的明星……
label.en: They're clearly not the brightest stars in the galaxy...

options.script: name = utopia.56.c

descriptions.zh:
以“寿无限”之名将产品推销上市后，[ointment_name.GetName]精华在星系间引起轩然大波。多亏发明人的个人魅力和可靠的推销策略，这种新型的神奇有机膏被广泛赞誉。每个星系的个体物种的明星们都“寿无限，无限延寿”了起来。

博士是怎么取得这么多[target_country.GetSpeciesAdj]腺体以让血清进行大规模生产的，至今还是个谜。
descriptions.en:
Marketed under the name "Ageless," the Essence of [ointment_name.GetName] has taken the galaxy by storm. Thanks to its charismatic inventor and a solid marketing campaign, the new "organic" miracle cream is being promoted everywhere. Stars, of the personal kind, in every system are "aging less with Ageless."

How the doctor has managed to procure enough [target_country.GetSpeciesAdj] glands to mass-produce the serum, however, remains a mystery...

descriptions.zh:
由于最近的失踪事件，[missing_pops_planet.GetName]上的动乱愈发严重。在过去的两月间，有数千名以上的居民失踪，其中绝大多数都是被孤立分化的偏远地区群体。这也解释了为什么这件事发生已然很长时间，但我们现在才注意到它。

当地执法部门已经要求更多的资源以进行进一步调查以及对骚乱的弹压。
descriptions.en:
Unrest is rising on [missing_pops_planet.GetName] in light of a recent wave of planetwide disappearances. Several thousand denizens have been reported missing in the last two months alone and the vast majority are from marginalized and isolated groups in remote areas. This could explain why it has taken so long to come to our attention.

Local law enforcement has requested additional resources to handle the growing unrest while they continue their investigation.

label.zh: 他们的失踪一定有什么原因……
label.en: Surely they were marginalized for a reason...

options.script: name = utopia.100.b

descriptions.zh:
关于发生在[missing_pops_planet.GetName]上的失踪事件，我们找到了些线索。他们所有人都在即将开业的太空赌场——天空之城中得到一个工作机会。那里的工作人员都穿着奇诡，说着莫名的外星语言。进一步的调查显示，如果这个赌场真的存在，那么它不位于这个星系的任何已知区域内。

专门打击力量的存在似乎使绑匪不敢进行下一次行动，我们已减弱了警力来引蛇出洞，以便当地执法部门抓捕绑架人员。
descriptions.en:
The investigation into the missing denizens of [missing_pops_planet.GetName] has revealed that they were all offered a job at a soon-to-open space casino called "Sky Castle," by sharp dressed recruiters speaking an unidentified alien language. Further inquiry has revealed that if such a casino does in fact exist, it is not within any known part of the galaxy.

As the presence of the strike force seems to be deterring the kidnappers from striking again they have been relieved to give local law enforcement a chance of luring the abductors back out.

options.script: name = utopia.101.a

descriptions.zh:
我们的科学家警告称，一个可疑的经销商正在我们的帝国内出售一种被称为寿无限的有机抗衰老霜。

他们的标语是——寿无限，使你寿命无限，这款广受欢迎的药用化妆品的原料是一种神秘的奇迹提取物，[ointment_name.GetName]精华。

虽然其有可能带来些令人不安的副作用，但是这款产品显示出了其促进细胞再生的极大潜力，研究委员会极力建议我们购买一批新产品。
descriptions.en:
Some of our scientists have raised the alarm on a new "all organic" anti-aging cream called Ageless, that is being sold throughout the empire by a seemingly questionable distributor.

Advertised under the slogan "Age less with Ageless", the wildly popular cosmeceutical is said to promote cell regeneration with a "unique formula" containing the mysterious miracle ingredient "Essence of [ointment_name.GetName]".

Though it can cause some very disturbing side-effects the product has shown real potential of stimulating cell growth and our research council highly recommends procuring a shipment to recreate its formula.

label.zh: 改善细胞再生听起来挺有前途。
减少皱纹并不是一个全国性问题。
label.en: Wrinkle reduction is hardly a national concern.

options.script: name = utopia.102.b

descriptions.zh:
我们对这种抗衰老软膏的研究和深入分析充分的揭示了其神秘奇迹原料的本质，[ointment_name.GetName]精华实际上是一种从活体[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]腺体中获得的一种提取物，毫无疑问这是一种痛苦而危险的野蛮行径。

而好消息是，这让我们发现了一种能够刺激腺体的注射形式，能够显著提高我们的预期寿命，似乎再生的钥匙一直都隐藏在我们身体里面！
descriptions.en:
A thorough analysis of the anti-aging cream "Ageless" has revealed that the origin of the rejuvenating miracle ingredient, "Essence of [ointment_name.GetName]", is quite close to home. In fact it can only be extracted from the glands of live [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], in a barbaric procedure that is undoubtedly both painful and dangerous.

In better news these finds have allowed us to create an injection that stimulates the gland, improving life-expectancy significantly. It seems that the key to regeneration was inside us all along!

label.zh: 找到那个实施这种暴行的卑鄙生物！
label.en: Find the vile creatures that did this to us!

descriptions.zh:
在军队和社会学研究部门的联合努力下，寿无限抗衰老霜的供应链已经被我们锁定，供应方是一个[fountain_of_youth_country.GetName]所有的科学枢纽 ，该机关曾隶属于某个政府，由艾克斯哈索尔博士及其科研团队组成。

[fountain_of_youth_country.GetName]从其中获取了巨大的利润，当然，他们不太可能知道原料的来源。
descriptions.en:
In a coordinated effort between the military and the society research department, we have followed the distribution chain of the "Ageless" anti-aging cream back to a Science Nexus owned by the [fountain_of_youth_country.GetName], where it was developed by a government-employed researcher named Dr. Xhaxxore and his team.

The [fountain_of_youth_country.GetName] has been making a huge profit off of the product and it seems unlikely that they wouldn't know the source of its key ingredient.

label.zh: 他们必须立即释放受害者并召回所有产品！
label.en: They must release the victims and withdraw the product immediately.

tooltips.zh: 派出特使去好言相劝。
tooltips.en: Sends an envoy with our civilly worded request.

options.script:
name = utopia.104.c
custom_tooltip = utopia.104.c.tooltip

tooltips.zh: 对于外交事务来说，这已经太晚了。
tooltips.en: It is much too late for diplomatic exchanges.

label.zh: 我们不可能去引起一场外交事故。
label.en: We cannot risk a diplomatic incident.

options.script: name = utopia.104.d

descriptions.zh:
据称，[target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]发现了我们绑架并囚禁他们物种中的一些成员的证据，并称我们的目的是从这些活体中提取一种能够让细胞再生的酶。

他们要求我们立刻释放这些实验体并召回所有产品，否则两国之间的和平就无法得到保证。接受他们的要求就意味着我们的秘密实验计划将会流产。
descriptions.en:
We have had word from the [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who claim to have uncovered evidence of our involvement in the kidnapping and unlawful imprisonment of several of their kind, for the purpose of extracting a cell regenerating enzyme from their glands.

They demand that we release them and withdraw the product in the interest of keeping the peace between our empires. Adhering to their demands would mean the premature end to our clandestine credit-generating scheme...

label.en: We have no interest in keeping the peace...

tooltips.zh: 无视他们的要求。
tooltips.en: Ignores their request.

descriptions.zh:
我们赢得了这场正义的战争！

尽管[fountain_of_youth_country.GetName]很明显在撒谎，声称他们自己从未知道这种[ointment_name.GetName]是如何制造的，至少他们释放了我们的公民回到[missing_pops_planet.GetName]上。

这项研究的带头者艾克斯哈索尔博士已经悄悄的跑路了，但研究团队的其他成员将受到正义的审判。
descriptions.en:
We have fought the good fight and won!

Though the [fountain_of_youth_country.GetName] claim they never knew of the sinister origins of the "Essence of [ointment_name.GetName]," which is clearly a lie, at least they had the decency of returning our citizens to their home on [missing_pops_planet.GetName].

As for Dr. Xhaxxore, the head researcher and mastermind behind the scheme, he has escaped under mysterious circumstances, but the rest of his team is being brought to justice.

options.script: name = utopia.106.a

descriptions.zh: 我们收到了来自[fountain_of_youth_country.GetName]的正式回信，他们坚持否认进行过抗衰老霜的开发，并劝告我们找点“更实际的方法来宣泄一下面对优越的[fountain_of_youth_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]时产生的自卑情绪，而非伪造证据来进行一些无意义的控诉。”
descriptions.en: We have received a formal reply from the [fountain_of_youth_country.GetName], forcefully denying their involvement in the production of the "Ageless" anti-aging cream and encouraging us to find "a more constructive outlet for our apparent inferiority complex towards the superior [fountain_of_youth_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], than the fabrication of toothless accusations".

descriptions.zh:
我们还未收到[target_country.GetName]对于他们绑架并进行活体实验来制造抗衰老霜的相关回复。但据可靠消息称，艾克斯哈索尔已经携带剩余的精华潜逃，为他们的牟利画上了句号。

我们的目标很明确，我们要把那些仍在受苦的受害者们，连同他们的家人一同带回[missing_pops_planet.GetName]。
descriptions.en:
We have had no response from the [target_country.GetName] regarding their involvement in the kidnapping of our kind for the purpose of producing the anti-aging cream "Ageless". But word has it Dr. Xhaxxore has fled with most of what was left of the essence, finally putting an end to their profiteering.

Our thoughts go out today to the doctor's many victims who are still in captivity, and their families back on [missing_pops_planet.GetName].

options.script: name = utopia.107.a

titles.zh: 艾克斯哈索尔博士逃走了！

descriptions.zh: [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对我们否认我们牵涉绑架一事感到不满。并且，艾克斯哈索尔博士似乎察觉到了风声，带着实验体跑了，这让我们无法生产更多的抗衰老膏。
descriptions.en: The [target_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were not pleased that we denied our involvement in the kidnapping of their kind. What's more Dr. Xhaxxore, smelling smoke, has fled taking his supply of essence with him, making it impossible to produce more Ageless cream.

descriptions.zh:
艾克斯哈索尔带着所有研究成果走了，只留下了他那惊慌失措的团队。他们也对他的突然离去表示不解，也就是说，所有宣称了解博士品格，说博士是一个富有魅力，慷慨，愿意为他的团队做一切的天才的人，现在能提供的博士传奇成就的证据都不过是传闻而已。

我们只能承认葛洛亦克博士说他是骗子是对的，或者他拿着他神秘的精华去找出价更高的人去了。如果他再在哪用这个伎俩的话，我们会找到他的。
descriptions.en:
Xhaxxore is gone and he's taken all his research with him, leaving only his bewildered staff behind. They were as blindsided by his sudden disappearance as we were, and though all attest to the content of his character, painting a portrait of a charismatic and charitable genius who would do anything for his team, they could only offer anecdotal evidence of his achievements.

We can only speculate as to whether Dr. Groik was right to call him a fraud, or whether he took his miracle essence to a higher bidder. If he ever tries a similar scheme elsewhere, we will find him.

options.script: name = utopia.58.a

descriptions.zh:
葛洛亦克博士和她的团队发明了一个神经库——一台能储存并使用所有上传至其驱动的大脑认知能力的有机计算机，这能极大提高我们的研究速度。不过有一个缺陷：为了有效运行，上传的大脑必须从对象身体中取出并放置在传导性液体中。对象必须和物质存在切断关系。

正如预料的那样，志愿者并没有多到要排队，目前为止只有一个——科学家[volunteer_leader.GetName]。
descriptions.en:
Dr. Groik and her team have invented a neural bank - an organic computer that stores and harnesses the collective cognitive power of all brains that are uploaded to its drive, greatly improving our research speed. But there's one hitch - to function properly, the uploaded brains have to be extracted from the subjects' bodies and placed within a tank of conductive fluids. Since our bodies can not survive long without a brain, subjects will have to leave their material existence behind.

As expected, volunteers have not been lining up. So far there has been only one - science leader [volunteer_leader.GetName].

tooltips.zh:
科学枢纽现在将提供额外的：
£physics£§G50§!£society£§G50§!£engineering£§G50§!
tooltips.en:
The Science Nexus will now produce an additional:
£physics£ §G50§! £society£ §G50§! £engineering£ §G50§!

name = utopia.59.c

descriptions.zh:
葛洛亦克博士和她的团队发明了一个神经库——一台能储存并使用所有上传至其驱动的大脑认知能力的有机计算机，这能极大提高我们的研究速度。不过有一个缺陷：为了有效运行，上传的大脑必须从对象身体中取出并放置在传导性液体中。对象必须和物质存在切断关系。

正如预料的那样，志愿者并没有多到要排队，目前为止只有一个——葛洛亦克的团队里一个优秀的年轻科学研究者。但她的家人提出1000点能量币的赔偿。
descriptions.en:
Dr. Groik and her team have invented a neural bank - an organic computer that stores and harnesses the collective cognitive power of all brains that are uploaded to its drive, greatly improving our research speed. But there's one hitch - to function properly, the uploaded brains have to be extracted from the subjects' bodies and placed within a tank of conductive fluids. Since our bodies can not survive long without a brain, subjects will have to leave their material existence behind.

As expected, volunteers have not been lining up. So far there has been only one - a bright young researcher on Groik's team. However, she has a family to provide for and requests monetary compensation of 1000 credits for them.

descriptions.zh:
就在刚才科学枢纽物理部门的工作人员全体昏迷了近15分钟。当他们醒来时物理学家[abducted_leader.GetName]失踪了，[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]的办公室被翻了个底朝天，[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]的存储器被清空，[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]的驱动也被烧焦了。

[abducted_leader.GetHerHisCap]的同事认为那是[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]保存文件用于[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]个人研究的地方。虽然[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]对自己的研究闭口不提，看起来[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]的研究已经快要取得突破了。

有些工作人员提及在失去知觉前见过紫色的亮光，目前没有有关[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]去向的线索。
descriptions.en:
Just now the staff of the Science Nexus physics department simultaneously blacked out for almost 15 minutes. When they woke up again physics leader [abducted_leader.GetName], was missing, [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] office had been upturned, [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] storage emptied and [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] drives fried.

[abducted_leader.GetHerHisCap] colleagues believe that's where [abducted_leader.GetSheHe] kept data on a personal project [abducted_leader.GetSheHe] [abducted_leader.GetWasWere] working on. Though tight-lipped about [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] research, it seems [abducted_leader.GetSheHe] [abducted_leader.GetWasWere] nearing a breakthrough.

Several of the staff mentioned seeing a bright purple light before losing consciousness. There have been no other clues as to [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] whereabouts.

options.script:
name = utopia.62.a
hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = utopia.63 days = 360 random = 20 } }

descriptions.zh:
这个上午的早些时候科学枢纽的工作人员发现失踪的物理学家[abducted_leader.GetName]在餐厅吃早餐，好像什么都没有发生过一样。

[abducted_leader.GetSheHeCap]宣称[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]刚从[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]床上爬起来，并且没有有关离开科学枢纽的回忆，但数位[abducted_leader.GetHerHis]同事声称[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]让同事感到不适，而[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]只是假装不记得。

[abducted_leader.GetSheHeCap]回归之后，对以前[abducted_leader.GetHerHim]不擅长的领域简直了如指掌。[abducted_leader.GetSheHe]目前正在等待指派。
descriptions.en:
Early this morning the Science Nexus staff discovered missing physics leader [abducted_leader.GetName] in the canteen, having breakfast, as if nothing happened.

[abducted_leader.GetSheHeCap] claim[abducted_leader.GetSXX] [abducted_leader.GetSheHe] awoke in [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] bed just moments previously and has no recollection of ever leaving the Science Nexus. But several of [abducted_leader.GetHerHis] colleagues have voiced concerns that [abducted_leader.GetSheHe][abducted_leader.GetSRe] making the staff uncomfortable and that [abducted_leader.GetSheHe][abducted_leader.GetSRe] only pretending not to remember.

[abducted_leader.GetSheHeCap] [abducted_leader.GetHasHave] also returned with an uncanny understanding of subjects previously unknown to [abducted_leader.GetHerHim]. [abducted_leader.GetSheHe] [abducted_leader.GetIsAre] currently awaiting assignment.

options.script: name = utopia.63.a

But there's one hitch - to function properly, the uploaded brains have to be extracted from the subjects' bodies and placed within a tank of conductive fluids. Since our bodies can not survive long without a brain, subjects will have to leave their material existence behind.

As expected, volunteers have not been lining up. So far there has been only one - science leader [volunteer_leader.GetName].

tooltips.zh:
科学枢纽现在将提供额外的：
£physics£§G50§!£society£§G50§!£engineering£§G50§!
tooltips.en:
The Science Nexus will now produce an additional:
£physics£ §G50§! £society£ §G50§! £engineering£ §G50§!

options.script: name = utopia.59.b
name = utopia.59.c

descriptions.zh:
我们已开始着手庞大的科学枢纽的建设。基座已就位，主轴已准备。对突破性科技的允诺以及对大胆设想的超越都将等待着我们。路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。

宇宙无尽的谜团最终都能被我们所掌控吗？
descriptions.en:
We have now begun the massive undertaking of constructing a Science Nexus. The foundation is in place and preparations are underway to add the main hub. The promise of new groundbreaking technologies and the realization of ideas beyond our wildest imaginations await. And though the road ahead is long and full of challenges, we have taken the first step.

Could the endless mysteries of the universe finally be within our grasp?

options.script: name = utopia.80.a

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]开始挑战科学枢纽的建设——一座科技极其先进的科研设施，足以让科学进程产生革命性颠覆。

[think_tank_system.GetName]星系热火如荼，工程师们正在组装建筑初始平台。无论他们成功与否，单纯这次尝试就足以让他们成为我们这一时代的先行者。
descriptions.en:
The [From.GetName] have taken on the challenge of building a Science Nexus - a research institute, so technically advanced, that it could revolutionize the scientific process completely.

The [think_tank_system.GetName] system is bustling with activity as engineers are assembling the initial build site. Regardless of whether they fail or succeed, trying alone has earned them a place among the great forerunners of our time.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]开始着手建造另一个科学枢纽，这一次是在[think_tank_system.GetName]星系。
descriptions.en: The [From.GetName] have begun to construct yet another Science Nexus, this time in the [think_tank_system.GetName] system.

label.en: A testament to the ingenuity of intelligent life.

options.script: name = utopia.82.a

label.zh: 一如既往，他们如此超前。

options.script: name = utopia.82.b

label.zh: 我们将粉碎[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，让其为之燃烧……

options.script: name = utopia.82.c

descriptions.zh: 科学枢纽的中央核心已就位，这个核心安装了一个最新工艺水平的奇点反应堆。我们的工程师准备加装下一个，也是最有挑战的设施片段——四个研究辅翼，足够承载极端炎热，极端的压力波动，以及外星病原体。辅翼也能为研究者提供很多住房。
descriptions.en: The Science Nexus central hub is now in place, equipped with a state of the art singularity reactor. Our engineers are preparing to add the next, most challenging segment of the facility - the four research wings. They will be fitted with pioneering technology - able to withstand everything from violent heat to intense pressure waves and alien pathogens. They will also provide housing for our many researchers.

options.script: name = utopia.83.a

descriptions.zh: 第一个模组——四个研发辅翼已就位，研究者与工作人员已前往他们的生活分区。下一步也是最后一部我们将延展辅翼，添加四个实验室区间以支持我们最危险的研究。我们已采取进一步的安保来保证工作人员的安全。
descriptions.en: The first module of the four research wings is now in place and researchers and staff are already moving into the living quarters. The next and final step of construction will extend the wings, adding four sections of laboratories equipped to support our most dangerous research. Extensive security measures are being taken to ensure the staff's safety.

options.script: name = utopia.85.a

descriptions.zh:
今天我们庆祝这个伟大的科学枢纽的开启。伴随着它那最尖端的科研设备与革新科技，我们可以毫无阻力地吸引全星系甚至整个宇宙最伟大的头脑，这正是我们希望的。这项功绩将成为一个新启蒙时代的开端。

今天会是我们物种历史中伟大的一天。
descriptions.en:
Today we celebrate the grand opening of the Science Nexus. With its state of the art research facilities and innovative technology we will have no trouble attracting the greatest minds from across the empire, or even the universe, should we so desire. This feat truly marks the beginning of a new era of enlightenment.

It is a big day in the history of our kind.

descriptions.zh: 今天我们庆祝着另一个科学枢纽的完成。如果我们之前的成就还不够的话，这一个科学枢纽的完成定能将我们置于宇宙科学进步的前沿。我们的科学进步让我们能自己定夺我们的未来。
descriptions.en: Today we celebrate the completion of yet another Science Nexus. If our previous accomplishments hadn't already, this will surely earn us a place on the forefront of scientific progress in the universe. Our technological advancements will allow us to shape the future to our liking.

options.script: name = utopia.84.a

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]完成了科学枢纽的建造。现在他们有能力反驳所有对他们有疑惑的人，并让他们处在科学进步的前沿。我们也许要注意他们，完成这样一个建筑未来必然会造福于他们的科技，让他们获得对我们的文明的优势。
descriptions.en: The [From.GetName] have constructed a Science Nexus, disproving all who doubted and placing them on the forefront for scientific progress. We may want to keep an eye on them, as the completion of such a structure will surely propel their technology into the future, giving them an advantage over other civilizations.

options.script: name = OK

descriptions.zh:
群星的光芒暗淡，虚空的黑暗消失，只有我们学会超越光速之后，我们才知道光揭示的只是真相的一角。

今天我们将终结我们的黑朦，我们准备在[From.solar_system.GetName]星系建造的哨兵阵列将成为坚实的全景监狱，我们的双眼将紧盯着每一颗恒星。
descriptions.en:
The light of suns blinds and the darkness of the void hides; only when we learned to travel faster than light did we learn just how little the light reveals.

Today, we begin to end this amaurosis of ours. The Sentry Array we prepare to build in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system will one day become a stalwart panopticon, our eye on every star.

options.script:
name = utopia.4100.a
custom_tooltip = utopia.4100.a.tooltip

tooltips.zh: §H哨兵阵列基址§!现已就位，但在上线运行前尚需进一步建造。
tooltips.en: The §HSentry Array Site§! is in place, awaiting further development before it can be brought online.

descriptions.zh: 我们收到消息，[From.GetName]开始在[spy_system.GetName]星系建造一个庞大，长程传感阵列。虽然还在早期阶段，完全完成的阵列将提供给他们全星系完全的星际活动动向。
descriptions.en: Word has reached us that the [From.GetName] has begun the construction of a vast, long-range sensor array in the [spy_system.GetName] system. While still in its early stages, the completed array is set to give them unfettered insight into interstellar travel in this galaxy.

options.script: name = OK

descriptions.zh:
哨兵阵列中心本身就代表着目前的最高技术水平，其将监听站和太空望远镜合二为一。

但这只是这一伟大工程的第一块里程碑。
descriptions.en:
The hub of the Sentry Array is a state-of-the-art installation in its own right, half listening post and half space telescope.

However, it marks but the first milestone in this grand undertaking.

options.script:
name = OK
custom_tooltip = utopia.4103.a.tooltip

tooltips.zh: §H哨兵中心§!已上线运行。我们的传感器探测范围提升了。
tooltips.en: §HSentry Hub§! online. Our sensor range has been increased.

descriptions.zh:
被封装在围绕在哨兵阵列上的环中的科技应该被严加看管以防泄密。

不过它带来的效果毋庸置疑，我们现在几乎能完全掌控整个星系所有舰队的动向。
descriptions.en:
Exactly what technology is housed in the ring that encircles the Sentry Array is a closely guarded secret.

The results, however, are undeniable. We now have virtually perfect knowledge of all fleet movements in the galaxy.

options.script:
name = utopia.4104.a
custom_tooltip = utopia.4104.a.tooltip

tooltips.zh: 传感范围激活至星系级。
tooltips.en: Activates galaxy-wide sensor range.

descriptions.zh:
我们收到消息，[From.GetName]已经完成了位于[From.From.solar_system.GetName]星系的哨兵阵列的建造。

我们认为他们已经能完全掌握关于我方舰队位置和组成的情报。
descriptions.en:
We have received word that the [From.GetName] have completed their Sentry Array in the [From.From.solar_system.GetName] system.

We should assume that they now have virtually perfect intel pertaining to the location and make-up of our fleets.

options.script: name = OK

descriptions.zh: 掌控恒星的能量一直是[Root.GetAdj]工程师们的梦想，从粗劣的燃烧到拙劣地模仿恒星聚变，而现在我们要实现这个梦想。在[From.From.GetName]星系坐落着我们的脚手架，而我们即将在那建造戴森球，将[From.From.GetName]包裹并独占恒星强大的能量。
descriptions.en: Harnessing the power of the stars has been a dream of [Root.GetAdj] engineers throughout history - from crude combustion to the pale imitation of solar fusion - and we now stand ready to realize this dream. In the [From.From.GetName] system sits the scaffold upon which we will build a Dyson Sphere, encompassing [From.From.GetName] and monopolizing the cataclysmic power of the star.

options.script: name = utopia.4000.a

descriptions.zh:
[dyson_system.GetName]星系的剧烈活动泄露了[From.GetName]在建§H戴森球§!的情况。

虽然还在早期阶段，完全建造的戴森球将完全阻隔[dyson_system.GetName]的光照，光照将转变为[From.GetAdj]能量储存。
descriptions.en:
Frenetic activity in the [dyson_system.GetName] system betrays the construction of a §HDyson Sphere§! by the [From.GetName].

Still in its early stages, the completed sphere will eventually blot out the light of [dyson_system.GetName], its radiance diverted to [From.GetAdj] energy stores.

descriptions.zh: 所有数据显示，又一个星系[dyson_system.GetName]将成为[From.GetName]下一个戴森球的所在地。虽然要花上一段时间，这个巨型结构一旦完成将包裹恒星系的恒星。
descriptions.en: By all accounts, the [dyson_system.GetName] will soon play host to yet another Dyson Sphere operated by the [From.GetName]. Though it will take some time, the megastructure will completely envelop the system's primary star once completed.

label.zh: 所有星际势力终将驯服恒星。
label.en: All stellar powers must eventually tame the stars.

descriptions.zh:
随着框架已被安置，这个项目的庞大是显而易见的。

[From.From.GetName]在纤细的笼子里燃烧，但她将最终被[Root.GetAdj]太阳能板完全包围。
descriptions.en:
With the frame now in place, the awesome scale of the project is evident to all.

[From.From.GetName] burns in a spindly cage, but will eventually be completely surrounded by [Root.GetAdj] solar panels.

options.script: name = utopia.4003.a

descriptions.zh:
虽然没有完全完成，随着先进的太阳能收集器的安装，我们现在开始收获位于[From.From.GetName]恒星系的戴森球带来的利益。

随着建造继续，能量收入会继续增长，最终戴森球完成时我们将获得完全的运转能力。
descriptions.en:
While not yet complete, with the installation of advanced solar harvesters we have begun to reap the benefits of the Dyson Sphere being built in the [From.From.GetName] system.

The energy gains will only continue to increase as construction continues, eventually reaching full operational capacity when the Sphere is completed.

options.script: name = utopia.4004.a

descriptions.zh:
[From.From.GetName]星系的主星已被[Root.GetAdj]戴森球完全包裹。

我们的工程师们庆祝着这一胜利，而也理应如此。我们做到了只有少数星系帝国敢于尝试的壮举——完全俘获一颗恒星。
descriptions.en:
The [From.From.GetName] system's primary has now been completely enveloped by a [Root.GetAdj] Dyson Sphere.

Our engineers celebrate this as a great victory, and rightly so. We have achieved what only a handful of star empires in the history of the galaxy dared imagine - the total subjugation of a star.

options.script: name = utopia.4005.a

descriptions.zh:
我们现在准备开始这项史诗工程，环绕[From.From.GetName]星系的恒星来建造未来环形世界的初始框架。

这个框架所需的资源与矿物是史无前例的，我们成百上千最优秀的工程师准备好开始拆解恒星系内的行星，将这些物质用于环形世界建造。
descriptions.en:
We are now ready to begin the colossal task of building the initial frame of our future Ring World around the primary star of the [From.From.GetName] system.

The amount of resources and materials required to build this skeletal frame will be immense, and hundreds of thousands of our finest engineers stand ready to begin the process of dismantling the system's planetary bodies into matter which can be used in its construction.

options.script: name = "utopia.2000.a"

descriptions.zh: 我们收到消息[From.GetName]已着手在[ringworld_system.GetName]星系建造一个史诗级项目。他们旨在建造一个巨大的环形世界以环绕恒星系的恒星，作为项目的第一步他们开始将星系所有行星转换为巨型结构的金属骨架。
descriptions.en: Word has reached us that the [From.GetName] has undertaken a construction project of monumental proportions in the [ringworld_system.GetName] system. They intend to build a massive Ring World around the system's primary, and as a first step they have started to convert the matter of all nearby planetary bodies into an initial metal skeleton for the megastructure.

descriptions.zh: 我们收到消息[From.GetName]开始建造另一个环形世界，这次是在[ringworld_system.GetName]星系！和以前一样他们的工程师正在拆解星系的所有行星，用他们的资源和材料进行环形世界建造。
descriptions.en: We have received intelligence that the [From.GetName] is about to start construction on yet another Ring World, this time in the [ringworld_system.GetName] system! As before, their engineers are currently in the process of dismantling all planetary bodies in the system so that their resources and materials can be used in the Ring World's construction.

label.zh: 那个环会和我们的一样壮观吗？
label.en: Will it be as impressive as our own?

label.zh: 一项壮举，如果能完成的话。
label.en: An impressive project... if it is ever finished.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.From.GetName]星系建设的环形世界框架现以完成。虽然还有很多后续工作，这个周长近十亿千米的金属骨架的完成必将是工程界的一项壮举。

我们准备好建设真正意义上的宜居地了。
descriptions.en:
The skeletal frame of the Ring World we are building in the [From.From.GetName] system has finally been completed. Although there is still much left to do, the mere completion of this metal skeleton, which has a circumference of nearly a billion kilometers, must be considered an incredible feat of engineering.

We are now ready to start work on creating the actual habitats.

label.zh: 还有许多工作等着我们。

options.script: name = "utopia.2003.a"

descriptions.zh:
今天，我们的工程师和行星生态学家完成了位于[completed_ringworld_system.GetName]星系的环形世界最后一个宜居区间的建造。这个伟大的巨型结构的建造必将成为[Root.GetName]历史的里程碑。我们完成了屈指可数的文明才能完成的工作。

让这个环形世界成为一个永恒的见证：自从[Root.GetSpeciesName]物种从安全的母星踏足至如今，我们达成了什么样的成就。
descriptions.en:
Our engineers and planetary ecologists today finished the last of the habitat sections on the Ring World we built in the [completed_ringworld_system.GetName] system. The construction of this great megastructure must be considered a milestone in the history of the [Root.GetName] - we have accomplished what only a handful of civilizations in the history of our galaxy has managed before.

Let this Ring World stand forever as a testament to how much the [Root.GetSpeciesName] species has achieved since we first ventured beyond the safety of our homeworld's atmosphere.

descriptions.zh:
我们完成了位于[completed_ringworld_system.GetName]恒星系的环形世界宜居区间的建造，我们的工程师和生态学家又一次完成了不可能。

[Root.GetName]将被认为是全星系历史中最伟大的造匠之一。
descriptions.en:
We have concluded work on the habitat sections of the Ring World we built in the [completed_ringworld_system.GetName] system. Our engineers and ecologists have accomplished the impossible yet again.

The [Root.GetName] must now truly be considered one of the greatest builders in the history of the galaxy.

options.script: name = "utopia.2004.a"

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]完成了历史上屈指可数的文明才能完成的壮举——他们完成了位于[completed_ringworld_system.GetName]星系的巨型环形世界的建造。

这项科学奇迹将成为[From.GetSpeciesName]物种那举世瞩目的奇迹的见证，从默默无闻的开始以来他们一路走过了很久。
descriptions.en:
The [From.GetName] has accomplished what only a handful of civilizations in the history of our galaxy has managed before - they have finished construction of the colossal Ring World they were building around the primary star of the [completed_ringworld_system.GetName] system.

This technological marvel must be considered a testament to the impressive achievements of the [From.GetSpeciesName] species as a whole. They have certainly come a long way from their humble beginnings.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]完成了又一个环形世界的建造！这个壮观的巨型结构坐落在[completed_ringworld_system.GetName]星系，曾经这个星系的行星都以不见踪影，它们被拆解为建造用料。
descriptions.en: The [From.GetName] has finished another Ring World! This massive megastructure is located in the [completed_ringworld_system.GetName] system, which is now devoid of other planetary bodies since those that once existed were dismantled and used as building material.

label.zh: 也许我们也要考虑再建一些。
label.en: Perhaps we should consider building more as well.

label.zh: 又有一个？他们的资源用不完的吗？
label.en: Another one? Is there no limit to their resources?

descriptions.zh:
我们在[dyson_system.GetName]星系遇到了一个巨型结构的残骸，包围着这个恒星系的恒星。我们的科学家初步判断这曾是个“§H戴森球§!”——一个用于彻底利用恒星能量的巨型结构。它显然已经无法继续运转，这是由于它的主体遭受到了来自未知的能量武器的致命打击。

值得注意的是这个戴森球残骸周围同时也漂浮着许多舰船残骸。这个戴森球的本体很古老，但其周围的残骸云明显来自于更近的年代。这些残骸似乎大多来自两支舰队之间的一场激烈交战，这场战斗很可能因为争夺这个废弃戴森球的归属权而爆发。
descriptions.en:
We have encountered the remains of an enormous space structure in [dyson_system.GetName], encompassing the system's primary. Our scientists theorize that this may have once been a functional "§HDyson Sphere§!" - a megastructure designed to harness the power of a star. It is obviously no longer operational, with its hull having sustained critical damage from an unknown type of energy weapon.

Of note are also the large debris fields surrounding the sphere. Although the megastructure itself is ancient, much of the debris in the system appears to be significantly younger. Most of it seems to originate from two distinct battle fleets that pummeled each other into oblivion, possibly in a war to decide ownership over the shattered sphere at some point in more recent galactic history.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[dyson_system.GetName]星系遇到了一个戴森球的残骸。它显然已经无法继续运转，这是由于它的主体遭受了未知的能量武器的致命打击

值得注意的是这个戴森球残骸周围同时也漂浮着许多舰船残骸。这个戴森球的本体很古老，但其周围的残骸云明显来自于更近的年代。这些残骸似乎大多来自两支舰队之间的一场激烈交战，这场战斗很可能因为争夺这个废弃戴森球的归属权而爆发。
descriptions.en:
We have encountered the remains of a Dyson Sphere in the [dyson_system.GetName] system. It is obviously no longer operational, with its hull having sustained critical damage from an unknown type of energy weapon.

Of note are also the large debris fields surrounding the sphere. Although the megastructure itself is ancient, much of the debris in the system appears to be significantly younger. Most of it seems to originate from two distinct battle fleets that pummeled each other into oblivion, possibly in a war to decide ownership over the shattered sphere at some point in more recent galactic history.

label.zh: 它看起来与我们自己的戴森球功能相近。
label.en: It appears functionally similar to our own sphere.

descriptions.zh:
我们成功修复了位于[From.GetName]星系内的废弃戴森球。星系内庞大的碎片云被收集起来用于修复工程，这样既减少了我们资源的消耗，又为工作人员消除了一个潜在的航行风险。

这个巨型结构现已恢复正常运作，在沉寂了千百年后再次产出巨额的能源。
descriptions.en:
We have successfully repaired the ruined Dyson Sphere in the [From.GetName] system. The large debris fields present in the system were gathered for use in the repair effort, reducing both material costs and removing a potential navigational hazard for the work crews.

The great megastructure is now fully operational, generating vast amounts of energy again for the first time in eons.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 我们在[nexus_system.GetName]发现了一座巨大太空装置的残骸。该巨型结构似乎曾是一个巨大的§H科学枢纽§!。尽管其已废弃数千年，但其主体结构依然完好。
descriptions.en: The broken remnants of a colossal space installation have been found near the [nexus_system.GetName]. This megastructure appears to have once served as some kind of massive §HScience Nexus§!. Although the installation has obviously been abandoned for millennia, its hull is still reasonably intact.

label.zh: 它看起来与我们的科学枢纽具有相近的功能。
label.en: The concept appears similar to our own Science Nexus.

descriptions.zh: 在[From.GetName]附近的废弃科学枢纽已被完全修复了，并配备了[Root.GetName]的精英科学家。这个巨型结构仍然保持着设计师当初建造它时的初衷，在这个时代继续帮助我们解决更多的科学问题。
descriptions.en: The abandoned Science Nexus near [From.GetName] has been fully repaired and staffed by the brightest minds of the [Root.GetName]. As was no doubt its original purpose, the megastructure will now be put to use in answering the scientific questions of our time.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh:
在星系历史上的某个时间点，[sentry_system.GetName]星系曾建有过一个体积异常巨大的轨道设施，后来被有组织地拆毁。此星系大部分天体的行星同步轨道上都弥漫着大量的残骸，当中不乏大型空间站的外壳。

残骸中以一个庞大的§H哨兵阵列§!为最。经过我们初步的扫描结果推测，这个阵列强大到足以实时监控整个星系。
descriptions.en:
At some point in galactic history, the [sentry_system.GetName] system evidently supported a vast orbital infrastructure of unusual proportions which has since been systematically demolished. There are large concentrations of debris in geostationary orbits around most of the planetary bodies in this system, including several massive space station hulks.

The largest of these is a colossal §HSentry Array§!. Our initial scans suggest that when it was operational, this array was powerful enough to provide real-time sensor coverage over the entire galaxy.

label.zh: 我们已经有哨兵阵列了。
label.en: We already have one of those.

descriptions.zh:
虽然十分困难，我们的工程师还是设法修复了位于[From.GetName]恒星系的废弃哨兵阵列，并在过程中回收利用了散布在周围的空间站残骸。

时隔亿万年，哨兵阵列在轰鸣中再次投入运作，列阵之中能量充盈，借助它强力的信号，整个星系一览无余。
descriptions.en:
It wasn't easy, but our engineers have managed to restore the ruined Sentry Array in the [From.GetName] system. The other station hulks and the debris that surrounded them were converted into building material during the restoration effort.

For the first time in eons, the array now hums with energy. Its powerful antennas can once again see clear to the other side of the galaxy.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh:
这些环绕着[ring_system.GetName]星系中央恒星的残骸，来自一个古老的环形世界。任何曾经存在于这个恒星系的行星体，都在这个庞然大物的修建工程中被作为建筑材料而使用。

没有证据能够指明这个工程奇迹最初是被谁修建的，但这一定是一个高度先进文明的杰作。
descriptions.en:
The shattered remnants of an ancient Ring World encircle the star of the [ring_system.GetName] system. Any planetary bodies that may once have existed here must have been used as building material during this megastructure's construction.

No evidence hinting towards who originally built this marvel of engineering has been found, but it must have been the product of a very advanced culture.

label.zh: 至少他们和我们的文明一样先进。
label.en: As advanced as we are, at any rate.

descriptions.zh: 基于[From.GetName]星系的环形世界废墟，我们的工程师成功地将它的一个区段恢复运转。全新的环形世界生态结构几乎是由我们的行星学家从零开始规划，但现在它已经足够稳定，可以居住了。
descriptions.en: Building on what remains of the ruined Ring World in the [From.GetName] system, our engineers have managed to fully restore one of its sections. The new biosphere had to be created more or less from scratch by our leading planetologists, but it is now considered stable and ready for habitation.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 打造巨型艺术设施的第一步就要同时面临两个困难：修建一个巨大到能容纳一个错综复杂的展览馆的空间站与组织一场空前规模的展览会。当所有基本设施都准备完全时，修建保险库将成为第一要务。保险库必须足够安全以及牢固，专门用来保护这星系之中的艺术财富。
descriptions.en: The first stage of constructing a Mega Art Installation combined the difficulties of building a vast station with the complexities of organizing a museum and gallery on an unprecedented scale. With the basic structure in place, the Vault will be the top priority. Planned to be a marvel of security and stability, the Vault will contain and protect the artistic wealth of the galaxy.

options.script:
name = EXCELLENT
hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = built_mega_art }

descriptions.zh: 我们巨型艺术设施的第二阶段已经完成，填满保险库的工作已经开始。一只专门的运输舰队将会持续不断地将我们帝国的瑰宝运送到它们的新家来。同时，可供工作人员居住的住所以及更多的展览空间等其他建筑也正在建造。
descriptions.en: The second stage of our Mega Art Installation is complete and the process of filling the Vault has begun. A dedicated fleet of transport ships operates constantly to transport the treasure of our empire to its new home. Meanwhile, additional structures are being built to house the multitude of required staff, and to display a vast number of exhibits.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 展览空间站群目前已经建设完毕。这些空间站论单个都比许多普通的恒星基地要大，每天能够容纳数以百万计的访客。万事俱备，只待开门大吉，我们的展会将会展出来自星系各国的艺术臻品以彰显不同物种的多样性。运输第一批游客的舰船已经到站了。
descriptions.en: The Exhibition Stations are complete. Each larger than many Starbases, these stations can accommodate millions of visitors per day. Now ready to open at long last, they will show samples of art from every race to celebrate the diversity of the galaxy. The first fleet of transport ships carrying visitors is already making its approach.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_xenophile = yes }

descriptions.zh: 展览空间站群目前已经建设完毕。这些空间站论单个都比许多普通的恒星基地要大，每天能够容纳数以百万计的访客。万事俱备，只待开门大吉，我们的展会将会展示[From.Owner.GetAdj]的真正艺术作品！同时还会展出一小部分外星艺术作为陪衬。运输第一批游客的舰船已经到站了。
descriptions.en: The Exhibition Stations are complete. Each larger than many Starbases, these stations can accommodate millions of visitors per day. Now ready to open at long last, they will display the true glory of [From.Owner.GetAdj] art! A small selection of Xeno-art shall also be displayed for comparison and mockery. The first fleet of transport ships carrying visitors is already making its approach.

descriptions.zh: 展览空间站群目前已经建设完毕。这些空间站论单个都比许多普通的恒星基地要大，每天能够容纳数以百万计的访客。万事俱备，只待开门大吉，我们的展厅能够展示[From.Owner.GetSpeciesName]和来自星系其他地区的满目琳琅以涤荡普罗大众的心灵。运输第一批游客的舰船已经到站了。
descriptions.en: The Exhibition Stations are complete. Each larger than many Starbases, these stations can accommodate millions of visitors per day. Now ready to open at long last, they will display the artistry of [From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] and the galaxy to the delight of all. The first fleet of transport ships carrying visitors is already making its approach.

The first fleet of transport ships carrying visitors is already making its approach.
