descriptions.zh: 全副武装的战略指挥中心已经建设完成。目前我们军队的指挥精英们都已经集结于其中，它是如此的无坚不摧。因为既安全又集中，他们可以全心全意为如何最好地抓捕奴隶的计划服务。
descriptions.en: The armored hull of the Strategic Coordination Center is complete. Now housing the absolute cream of our military command, it is virtually impregnable. Secure and concentrated they are able to devote their every waking hour to planning how best to capture the maximum number of slaves.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_slaver = yes }

descriptions.zh: 全副武装的战略指挥中心已经建设完成。目前我们军队的指挥精英们都已经集结于其中，它是如此的无坚不摧。因为既安全又集中，他们可以全心全意为如何最好地征服星海的计划服务。
descriptions.en: The armored hull of the Strategic Coordination Center is complete. Now housing the absolute cream of our military command, it is virtually impregnable. Secure and concentrated they are able to devote their every waking hour to planning how best to conquer the galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 全副武装的战略指挥中心已经建设完成。目前我们军队的指挥精英们都已经集结于其中，它是如此的无坚不摧。因为既安全又集中，他们可以全心全意为如何最好地防御我国的计划服务。
descriptions.en: The armored hull of the Strategic Coordination Center is complete. Now housing the absolute cream of our military command, it is virtually impregnable. Secure and concentrated they are able to devote their every waking hour to planning how best to defend our empire.

descriptions.zh: 全副武装的战略指挥中心已经建设完成。目前我们军队的指挥精英们都已经集结于其中，它是如此的无坚不摧。因为既安全又集中，他们可以全心全意为如何最好地防御我国的计划服务。
descriptions.en: The armored hull of the Strategic Coordination Center is complete. Now housing the absolute cream of our military command, it is virtually impregnable. Secure and concentrated they are able to devote their every waking hour to planning how best to defend our empire.

options.script:
name = EXCELLENT
hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = built_SCC }

descriptions.zh: 强大的通信阵列已被加入到战略指挥中心之中，这样我们的舰船无论在哪都可以收到来自于我们的战略指令了。这些目前最为先进的通信阵列能够克服一切干扰，并且它量子纠缠的信号完全无法被破解。
descriptions.en: Powerful communication arrays have been added to the Strategic Coordination Center, enabling our strategists to issue orders to our ships throughout the galaxy. These state-of-the-art arrays are powerful enough to burn through any possible jamming, and the quantum-entangled signal is utterly unhackable.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

titles.zh: 战略指挥中心：全面运行

descriptions.zh: 战略指挥中心最后的附加部分是一些分离的"敌方军队"模拟堡垒。这些堡垒差不多就是战略指挥中心的微缩版，而且完全独立运行。精英指挥官和他的手下们在其中能够完整地沉浸在敌人的文化与传统之中，通过学习他们的艺术，能更好地理解并模拟他们的军事思想。当完全沉浸之后，他们会与战略指挥中心的工作人员开展一场场虚拟战争，使得我们能够模拟任何可能的冲突，并能从两边学习到所有的细节，我们便能够在实战当中拥有比敌人更加卓越的战术。
descriptions.en: The final additions to the Strategic Coordination Center are several detached "Hostile force" simulator bastions. These bastions contain much of the functionality of the Strategic Coordination Center on a smaller scale, but are completely independent of the main system. Within, elite commanders and their staff can become totally immersed in the culture and traditions of our enemies, and by studying their artwork can better understand and simulate their military thinking. Once fully immersed, they will fight virtual wars against the staff of the Strategic Coordination Center, allowing us to stimulate conflicts with any possible enemy in excruciating detail which can then be studied from the perspectives of both sides and our strategies refined upon.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh:
星际集会第一阶段最关键的特征的就是§S基座§!了。一个复杂的黑洞全息影像，它被用来召唤星系中心潜伏的引力深渊：那整个星系旋转的支点。

等到建成之后，这个地方也将会成为某些事务的轴心，那些能驱使整个星河旋转的静默外交与软实力博弈将会紧紧围绕着它。
descriptions.en:
The most crucial feature of the initial stage of the Interstellar Assembly is the §SLocus§!. A sophisticated holographic projection of a black hole, it is meant to evoke the gravitational chasm that lurks in the galactic core: the fulcrum upon which the galaxy turns.

Once fully built, this place will also be an axle of sorts, around which the quiet diplomacy and soft power that often drive the galaxy swirl.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 星际集会的第二阶段，领事环，现已建成。这个内环将能够容下我们大部分的外交人员在里面活动。
descriptions.en: The second stage of the Interstellar Assembly, the Consul Ring, is now complete. This inner circle will house most of our diplomatic staff going forward.

options.script:
name = EXCELLENT
hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = built_quantum_cat }

titles.zh: 星际集会：会议广场模块

descriptions.zh: 星际集会的外环将会配有大量最先进的隐私保护会议室（当然，只有[Root.GetAdj]能够进行监控）。这座空间站正在迅速成为非现场谈判方面无可辩驳的星系枢纽。
descriptions.en: The Interstellar Assembly's outer ring is populated with vast, state-of-the-art conference rooms equipped with privacy filters (penetrable only by [Root.GetAdj] surveillance, of course). The station is quickly becoming the de-facto galactic hub for off-site negotiations.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh:
星际集会已全力运作，目前正在招待星际间几股大势力的重要人物们，无论他们是政界还是商界的。

我们的外交官们在跟进空间站内传出的那些国家利益与政治羞辱的信息流时受了不少累。不过至少我们的客人对我们的监控并不关心，只要我们一直为他们提供这种同竞争对手角力的理想环境就好了。
descriptions.en:
The Interstellar Assembly is now fully operational, and plays host to a number of embassies from the galaxy's major powers, be they political or corporate.

Our diplomats are having a hard time keeping up with the steady flow of information on national interests and political embarrassments we are extracting from the station. At least our guests seem largely disinterested in our surveillance, as long as we provide the ideal environs for them to strong-arm their competitors.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 为了对[From.GetName]进行开采，我们首先需要一个安全基地才能开始建造其他。星锚已经在黑洞事件视界的最边缘处建造完成，并且已经由一个重力重定向引擎牢牢稳定住，通过逆转[From.GetName]自身产生的重力去抵抗巨大的引力。
descriptions.en: To extract matter from [From.GetName] we first need a secure base to build the facility on. The Anchor has been built on the very edge of the event horizon and is held in place against the immense gravitational pull by an advanced gravity redirection engine, which turns [From.GetName]'s own gravity against it.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 建造于现有重力重定向系统之上，重力透镜设施能够使一部分力穿过“透镜”，将力更加密集地集中在某一片选中的区域。
descriptions.en: Built on the existing gravity redirection system, the Gravity Lensing Facility is able to redirect a portion of the force into a "Lens", concentrating the force even more strongly in a selected area.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 从黑洞提取物质的关键就在于究极精致的重力重定向系统：在某个区域集中生成一片引力扭曲的区域，然后打造出一个专门用来应对重力情况下的大型重定向钻头。
descriptions.en: The key to extracting matter from the black hole is the ultimate refinement of the gravity redirection system: Forming a focused area of twisted gravity, in effect creating a vast drill whose bore is made of redirected and concentrated gravitational force.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 物质解压器的最后一步看上去十分单调，但也有他最令人震撼的一面。一大堆自动化的冶炼厂以及处理器开始将采取自[From.GetName]的物质分解，解压缩并分离为实用的矿物，再装入连续不绝的机械驳船舰队中，送往帝国各地。
descriptions.en: The final stage of the Matter Decompressor is the most mundane, but in its own way the most impressive. A vast automated array of smelters and processors break down, decompress, and separate the material of [From.GetName] into useful minerals which are decanted into an unending fleet of robotic barges to be delivered around our empire.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 我们在[matter_decompressor_system.GetName]的视界线上不可思议地存在着某种采矿装置。我们的科学家认为这可能是一个“§H物质解压器§!”——用于从黑洞中开采矿物的巨型结构。尽管它已无法正常运转，但某些阻止它被意大利面条化的装置一定仍在运作。
descriptions.en: Impossibly perched on the event horizon of [matter_decompressor_system.GetName] is some kind of mining apparatus. Our scientists theorize that this may be a "§HMatter Decompressor§!" - a megastructure designed to mine materials from a black hole. While it is no longer fully functional, some mechanism preventing its spaghettification must still be operational.

descriptions.zh: 位于[matter_decompressor_system.GetName]事件视界上的是一个“§H物质解压器§!”——一个从黑洞中获取矿物的巨型结构。即使机能不全，它的引力扭曲引擎一定仍在运作，否则它早就因为黑洞的引力变成一团意大利面条了。
descriptions.en: Perched on the event horizon of [matter_decompressor_system.GetName] is a "§HMatter Decompressor§!" - a megastructure designed to mine materials from a black hole. While it is no longer fully functional,  its gravitational twist engine must still be operational as it has not suffered spaghettification.

label.zh: 它似乎与我们自己的很像。
label.en: It seems similar to our own.

descriptions.zh:
伴随着吱呀声，物质解压器：锚定细长如虚幻般的横臂开始缓缓运转。

看起来摇摇欲坠的空间站的晃动渐渐停止，而阵阵能量与微粒物质从[From.GetName]事件视界的阴影中射出。
descriptions.en:
The spindly, ethereal leg-beams of the Matter Decompressor: Anchor sputter to life.

The spasms and paroxysms of the precarious station eventually give way to an even thrum of flowing energy and particulate matter, swept up from the umbra beyond [From.GetName]'s event horizon.

options.script: name = mega.1000.a.mater

descriptions.zh: 我们在[strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]发现了一座被毁的巨大空间站。它破碎的残骸中包含了大量的战斗计算机、模拟器、以及通讯阵列，因此我们的科学家认为这一定是某种“§H战略指挥中心§!”。
descriptions.en: A massive, ruined space station has been discovered in [strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]. Its shattered remains contain a plenitude of battlecomputers, simulators, and broadcasting arrays which leads our scientists to speculate it must have been some type of "§HStrategic Coordination Center§!".

descriptions.zh: 我们在[strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]发现了一座被毁的巨大空间站。它似乎是一座“§H战略指挥中心§!”的残骸。
descriptions.en: A massive, ruined space station has been discovered in [strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]. It appears to be the remains of a "§HStrategic Coordination Center§!".

label.zh: 我们的永远不会被摧毁!

descriptions.zh: 位于[From.GetName]的废弃战略指挥中心已被完全修复，并由[Root.GetName]最有才华的军事人员掌管。这座巨型结构将恢复其原本的功用，指挥我们整个星系中的军事力量。
descriptions.en: The abandoned Strategic Coordination Center in [From.GetName] has been fully repaired and staffed by the most brilliant military minds of the [Root.GetName]. True to its original purpose, the megastructure will be put to use coordinating our military might throughout the galaxy.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 我们在[mega_art_installation_system.GetName]中发现了三座被毁的空间站。它们被一团碎片所环绕，其中某些仍可辨识出是艺术品，虽然是非常异星的艺术品——看来这里曾是一座“§H巨型艺术设施§!”。
descriptions.en: A trio of wrecked space stations have been discovered in [mega_art_installation_system.GetName]. They are surrounded by a cloud of debris, some of which is still vaguely recognizable as works of art, albeit of a very alien nature. It seems that this was at one point a "§HMega Art Installation§!".

descriptions.zh: 我们在[mega_art_installation_system.GetName]发现了一座被毁的“§H巨型艺术设施§!”。其中的展品已遭受了时间与真空的摧残。
descriptions.en: A ruined "§HMega Art Installation§!" has been discovered in [mega_art_installation_system.GetName]. Time and vacuum-exposure have not been kind to the exhibits.

titles.zh: 被毁的巨型艺术设施已修复

descriptions.zh: 位于[From.GetName]的被毁巨型艺术设施已被修复完毕。除了[Root.GetName]最伟大的艺术品之外，它也陈列了一小部分从原本的巨型结构中回收并修复的外星艺术品。
descriptions.en: The once-ruined Mega Art Installation in [From.GetName] has been restored to operation. Fully repaired and stocked with a selection of the greatest artworks of [Root.GetName], it also contains a small selection of exhibits which were recovered and restored from the original megastructure.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 我们在[interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]发现了一座巨大的被毁空间站。从大量办公空间以及一座配有各种不同类型生命维持设施的论坛看来，我们的科学家认为这是一座“§H星际集会§!”的残骸。
descriptions.en: The remains of a vast space station have been found in [interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]. Judging by the amount of what seems to be office-space and a vast forum outfitted with dozens of different types of life-support systems, our scientists suspect that this is all that remains of an "§HInterstellar Assembly§!".

descriptions.zh: 我们在[interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]发现了一座“§H星际集会§!”的残骸，并辨别出了十几种不同物种的干尸。
descriptions.en: The remains of an "§HInterstellar Assembly§!" have been found in [interstellar_assembly_system.GetName]. The mummified remains of at least a dozen different species have been identified so far.

descriptions.zh: 位于[From.GetName]的星际集会已经再次上线了。它已准备好再次迎接星系中的外交官们，共同商讨当前太阳周期中的问题。
descriptions.en: The Interstellar Assembly in [From.GetName] is online again. Once more it is ready for the diplomats of the galaxy to gather in one place to debate the great issues of the current solar cycle.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 巨型船坞的第一阶段已经完工。等到各制造隔间安装在这一巨型框架上后，这个设施终有一天会成为全星系舰船制造的中心。
descriptions.en: The first stages of our Mega Shipyard is now complete. A vast framework awaits the installation of the manufacturing bays which will one day make this facility the shipbuilding capital of the galaxy.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 巨型船坞的核心已经就位，剩下的只有增添上海量的舰船建造锚地了。
descriptions.en: The core of the Mega Shipyard has been put in place, all that remains to add are the vast ship construction berths.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 巨型船坞现已完全上线，其可以生产空前数目的星舰。
descriptions.en: The Mega Shipyard is now fully online, it can produce starships in unprecedented volume.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh:
在[mega_shipyard_system.GetName]发现一巨大的外星设计的建筑。尽管它已经老化，我们的科学家还是确定这一巨型结构实际上是几个造船船坞的组合体——一个§Y巨型船坞§!。

倘若我们获取了如何修复巨型结构的知识和工业能力，我们的生产能力将会极大地提升。
descriptions.en:
In the vast reaches of the [mega_shipyard_system.GetName] system rests a vast structure of alien design. Despite its decrepit state, our scientists confirms that the megastructure is in fact a combination of several construction yards - a §YMega Shipyard§!.

If we were to acquire the knowledge on how to repair this magnificent, industrial facility, our production capabilities would increase immensely.

descriptions.zh: 在[mega_shipyard_system.GetName]发现一巨大的§Y巨型船坞§!结构——和我们建造的设计相似。尽管其已老化无法使用，但只需充足的资源，我们应该就能将其恢复至运作状态！
descriptions.en: In the vast reaches of the [mega_shipyard_system.GetName] system rests a vast §YMega Shipyard§! structure - similar to that of our own design. The megastructure is in a decrepit state, however, and needs extensive repairs in order to be brought back online.

label.zh: 想象一下我们拥有两个巨型船坞的情景！

descriptions.zh: 巨型船坞现已完全上线，其可以生产空前数目的星舰。
descriptions.en: The Mega Shipyard is now fully online, it can produce starships in unprecedented volume.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 我们的量子弹弓的第一阶段已经完工。精确的扭力透镜装置正在从恒星中充能，这些能量可以剧烈地释放出来，将舰船传送至极远距离外。
descriptions.en: The first stage of our Quantum Catapult is now complete. A precise arrangement of torsion lenses gains charge from the star, and can release this energy in an erratic fashion to send ships across great distances.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

titles.zh: 量子弹弓双排扭力透镜

descriptions.zh: 量子弹弓的第二个扭力透镜装置已经就位，并同第一个装置进行了平衡。射程和准确度都提高了。
descriptions.en: A second arrangement of Quantum Catapult torsion lenses is now in position, diametrically balancing the first. Range and accuracy are increased.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 对量子弹弓的最终精校完成，并且现在已完全上线运作。射程和准确度得到进一步改善。
descriptions.en: The final refinements have been made to the Quantum Catapult and it is now fully online. Both range and accuracy have been improved.

options.script: name = over.10.a

descriptions.zh:
在[quantum_catapult_system.GetName]星系中，有一个围绕着脉冲星的巨大残骸场。我们的科学家分析称，在残骸场内部最密集的区域所残存的部分完整结构似乎通过某种方式驾驭了恒星的力量，有将物体传送至极远距离的能力。

倘若我们获取了如何修复巨型结构的知识，我们将能够修复这座§Y量子弹弓§!。
descriptions.en:
A massive field of debris orbits the pulsar in the [quantum_catapult_system.GetName] system. Our scientists theorize that the partially intact structure in the densest portion of the field somehow harnessed the power of the star to launch objects incredible distances.

If we developed the knowledge to work on great megastructures, we could repair this §YQuantum Catapult§!.

descriptions.zh: 在[quantum_catapult_system.GetName]星系中，有一个围绕着脉冲星的巨大残骸场，其核心的结构与我们的§Y量子弹弓§!设计相似。经过彻底维修我们能够使其恢复运转。
descriptions.en: A massive field of debris orbits the pulsar in the [quantum_catapult_system.GetName] system - the structure in the center is similar to that of our own §YQuantum Catapult§! designs. With extensive repairs, we could return it to service.

label.zh: 想象一下我们拥有两个量子弹弓的情景！

descriptions.zh: 在[quantum_catapult_system.GetName]星系内的被毁的量子弹弓已被修复到可以运作的状态，现已能传送我们的舰队跨过星海。我们对它的科技有了全新的理解，在经过几轮测试之后，我们有信心能够安全地使用。
descriptions.en: The Ruined Quantum Catapult in the [quantum_catapult_system.GetName] system has been restored to operational status, and can now transport our fleets across the stars. We have developed a new understanding of its technology, and after a few test runs, we feel confident that we can use it safely.

descriptions.zh: 在[quantum_catapult_system.GetName]星系内的被毁的量子弹弓已被修复到可以运作的状态，现已能传送我们的舰队跨过星海。
descriptions.en: The Ruined Quantum Catapult in the [quantum_catapult_system.GetName] system has been restored to operational status, and can now transport our fleets across the stars.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 对从§Y[yuhtaan.GetName]§!星系取回的数据进行进一步分析发现，在其背景噪音中存在一个微妙的能量模式，源自小行星[jabbardeeni_cache.GetName]。
descriptions.en: Further analysis of the data recovered from the §Y[yuhtaan.GetName]§! system has revealed a subtle repeating energy pattern hidden in the background noise, coming from the asteroid [jabbardeeni_cache.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
一座历史可追溯回尤特-贾巴蒂尼大战时代的小型监听哨站，它在开战后不久就由贾巴蒂尼人建造，用来观测§Y[yuhtaan.GetName]§!，以防尤特人返回他们的母星系，而在这个小行星的内部深处暗藏着大量数据缓存。

在随后的数个世纪中，贾巴蒂尼人又将这个哨站改建成了一个用于进行他们在超光速航行中最新实验的测试场所。尽管这些数据大多数仅仅是理论上的，但仍有一些可以派上用场。
descriptions.en:
A small listening outpost dating back to the ancient Yuht-Jabbardeeni conflict with a substantial data cache was hidden deep within the asteroid, built by the Jabbardeeni after the war to observe §Y[yuhtaan.GetName]§! in case any Yuht returned to their home system.

In the centuries that followed, the Jabbardeeni repurposed the outpost into a testing site for some of their more novel experiments in faster-than-light travel. While the data is mostly theoretical, some may still be of use.

descriptions.zh:
大功告成了。今天，我们骄傲地向星系交出我们最伟大的成绩单：我们的超空间中继器网道与我们的亲密友邦§Y[from.GetName]§!紧紧相连了起来。

在[root.GetName]各地都在举行盛大的庆典，一致宣布这个我们共同引以为豪的新网道。据说就在此刻，我们冰释一切前嫌；放下了一切傲慢与成见。我们期盼在未来的日子里能够继续共享这份骄傲和与豪情。通过亲密无间的协作，我们打破了曾经一度认为不可逾越的壁垒，开启了友谊、共荣的新时代。
descriptions.en:
It is done. Today, we present the galaxy with one of our grandest accomplishments yet: the joining of our Hyper Relay network with that of our friends, the §Y[from.GetName]§!.

Lavish ceremonies have been held throughout the [root.GetName], unanimously heralding this proud new link we share. It is said that for the moment, all petty jealousies have been forgotten; all apathies and indifferences cast aside. Blended with this sense of pride and ambition is a shared confidence in the days to come. Working side by side we have torn down a barrier we once thought insurmountable, ushering in a new age of mutual prosperity and friendship.

descriptions.zh:
今天，我们将自己深深铭刻在了星系无与伦比的辉煌历史当中。随着我们超空间中继器网道与§Y[from.GetName]§!网道的全线贯通，我们的公民现在可以毫无阻碍地前往那些邻近的恒星系。

另一方面，[from.GetAdj]也热烈接纳我们[root.GetAdj]的影响力。相信用以塑造我们自己灿烂辉煌恒星系的文化也能让他们从中收益。
descriptions.en:
Today we have etched ourselves further into a record of unparalleled galactic splendor. With the linking of our Hyper Relay network to that of the §Y[from.GetName]§!, our citizens may now venture into those neighboring systems without let or hindrance.

The [from.GetAdj], in turn, now welcome the embrace of our rich [root.GetAdj] influence. They too shall benefit from the bounteous culture which defines our own, magnificent star systems.

descriptions.zh:
今天，对我们而言星系中的阻碍又少了一个，我们与[from.GetName]的合作已经取得了丰硕的成果。与我们相邻超空间中继网道中的最后一个链接已经上线，从此双方可以便捷地通过彼此的边境。

出现在我们面前的是通往未知的旅程，因为这一架构会带来的一切机遇与挑战对我们和[from.GetName]都是等同的。我们将拭目以待，我们的邻国是如何看待这个相互信任的象征。
descriptions.en:
The galaxy presents one less hurdle to us today, as our co-operative effort with the [from.GetName] has reached a fruitful conclusion. The last link in our adjoining Hyper Relay networks has been brought online, inviting both partners into rapid transit across our shared border.

What awaits us now is a journey into the unknown, for every aspect of this arrangement - positive or negative - applies equally to us and the [from.GetName]. We shall see how well our neighbors hold to this symbol of mutual trust.

label.zh: 这是值得所有人自豪的一天。
